description: Legacy float arithmetic drifts one cent on interest for amounts above 1e13 cents; the new service uses exact integer math. Unreachable while C1 rejects amounts above 1e12 in the new service, kept so the entry applies if that cap is ever lifted.
Legacy INT columns clamp values above 2147483647 cents; the new service stores the exact BIGINT value.
Legacy utf8_general_ci collation treats message ids that differ only by case, accents or trailing spaces as the same message; the new service keeps them as distinct messages.
The new service rejects amountCents above 1e12 with invalid_payload, so the message never reaches the shadow table; the legacy accepts it.
